reviews.comment: I have only superlatives for Sunlogic. They started by meeting a very short deadline I had to install an inverter and battery for my solar system when I explained to them why it was urgent. Their work was of the highest quality, and Stephan, head of installations, and Craig, head of sales, are a formidable team. They are truly customer and service oriented and provide generous follow-up service when needed. Highly recommended !!
